<!-- pr-reviewer: 8845b68d430a4a8327a6259fdbf446c6057a6178 -->
Delta review of 3b9ef78..8845b68 (merge-plan class: NEW CODE). Verdict: the refresh is clean, but main has moved again and the PR now conflicts. It needs a re-merge of main.

What looks good
- `pick.rs` keeps both sides' exports: the PR's `lay_on_plane_in` and `lay_on_points_in`, and main's circle and centre exports.
- `shell.rs` is main's version plus the one `align_pick_viz::paint` call. That call is the only difference from main, so the alignment overlay is intact and nothing else was dropped.
- The fold commit (c823734b) changes wording only. "Part alignment", "Turn", "Picked: nothing picked yet" and the `picks_text` readout are main's again, and the flow text is a tooltip. Each changed assertion now pins main's wording, and none was removed.
- The command paths are unchanged. No snapshot PNG is touched, and no `unwrap` or `expect` was added.

Results (locally, in a worktree at head 8845b68, without merging current main)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` filtered runs: setup_align 5 passed, setup_axis 9 passed, setup_plane 5 passed, setup_points 3 passed, plane_face_pick 4 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- I did not use the runner, because a trial merge with current main conflicts.

Requested before merge
1. Merge current main (0b4052bb) into the branch. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/setup_align_tests.rs` conflicts, because main changed it since the last refresh.

Notes (not blocking)
- Before/after screenshots are still owed. The maintainer has decided "Merge without screenshots" for UI PRs, so this does not block.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
